Slay the Spire is one of those games that looks simple at first, then somehow steals 100 hours of your life.

The gameplay loop is ridiculously addictive. Build a deck, make questionable decisions, convince yourself this run is “the one,” then get absolutely demolished because you got greedy three floors ago. Every run feels different enough to keep things interesting, and there’s a surprising amount of strategy behind what cards you take, what you skip, which relics you build around, and when to take risks.

What I really like is that losing rarely feels pointless. You’re constantly learning better card combinations, enemy patterns, and new ways to build each character. There’s always that feeling of “I could have won if I had just done this differently,” which immediately turns into another run.

Easy to learn, difficult to master, endlessly replayable.

10/10. I’ll stop after one more run.

Something about this very simple and straightforward game just kept me coming back for more. A combination of understanding card synergies, the variety of strategies and enemies to prepare for and the close-yet-so-far feeling when I lost just made for addictive cycle of trial & error (in the best way possible). 

If you enjoy grinding your way to the top, this game is for you!

I feel completely confused. Am I playing the same game as everyone else?

The game is so boring to me. I keep trying to play it from different angles and at different times over the years, but every attempt just hits the same wall. There’s too much RNG, and I’ve tried building my card deck around it, but it’s still just not fun.
Each run doesn’t feel like I’m getting stronger with each new card because, again, it all comes down to RNG. And after unlocking the new cards, there’s nothing more that makes me want to keep playing.
So seeing people play this for hundreds and hundreds of hours completely confuses me. Where is the part of the game that could make me want to spend that much time with it?

I have about 500 hours of this on my phone.

I don't think words can fully express just how good this game is. This might be the best game ever made. The entire game looks like it was made with a few people who were very good at MS paint and then slapped some animations together and made the best game ever. Most characters attack by just slightly moving a few centimetres to the left and then hitting you for 25 damage. It is just incredibly good in every single way and when you have a good deck, you feel like you're actively giving the middle finger to the developers. Like there's no way they expected me to have 99 energy and 850 block on turn 4.

Fantastic game. Challenging. Unique. Creative. Replayable. And by far deserving of its stupidly low price. You can regularly find this game on sale for like 7 bucks. Buy it. Spend 2500 hours playing it. Recommend it to all your friends. Play it on your phone at your wedding.

Not typically a deck-builder or rogue-like game enjoyer. But this game really hooks you. Because it isn't like Hearthstone where the barrier to entry is massive, this actually allows you to learn and improve at the game at your own pace. I am really enjoying both learning how to be a better player, and be challenged every time I play. Mostly, I enjoy that it is a PVE game where there isn't a pressure of seasons, and quickly ranking up, etc.
I feel like I am just at the beginning of a fun journey with this game.
